input.quote: Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others.
input.rationale: No most-favoured-nation, pricing-parity or best-terms undertaking appears anywhere in the Agreement. Targeted searches for "no less favourable", "most favored", "favorable/favourable", "best price", "parity", "any other customer" and "competitor" returned nothing, and the two candidate sections are silent: § 4.1 Charges simply says Charges are set in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms, and § 13.3 Amendments only requires a signed writing. Conversely, § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) expressly confirms each party may enter into similar agreements with others, which is inconsistent with any obligation on Bluefly to extend IBM terms given to third parties. Since there is no MFN running against the Customer, the preferred position is met and no redline is warranted.
